description: Provides a visual console for playground output.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code: Inspect these example messages, then use Clear to empty the console.

methods.name: addEntry(kind: TpConsoleEntryKind, values: TpConsoleValue[]): TpConsoleEntry
methods.description: Appends an entry of kind containing values, rerenders the console and returns the created entry record.

methods.name: assert(condition: unknown, ...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Adds an assertion-failure entry only when condition is falsy, including the supplied values.

methods.name: clear(): void
methods.description: Removes all entries.

methods.name: count(label = "default"): void
methods.description: Increments the counter associated with label and displays its new value; a new counter starts at one.

methods.name: countReset(label = "default"): void
methods.description: Resets the counter associated with label so its next count starts again at one.

methods.name: error(...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Writes an error entry.

methods.name: getEntries(): TpConsoleEntry[]
methods.description: Returns a copy of the displayed entries.

methods.name: getValue(): string
methods.description: Returns the text copied by the toolbar copy button.

methods.name: group(...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Starts an expanded group.

methods.name: groupCollapsed(...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Starts a collapsed group.

methods.name: groupEnd(): void
methods.description: Ends the current group.

methods.name: info(...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Writes an informational entry.

methods.name: log(...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Writes a standard entry.

methods.name: redirectConsoleToSelf(): () => void
methods.description: Routes global console methods to this component and returns a cleanup function that restores the previous methods.

methods.name: restoreConsole(): void
methods.description: Restores the original global console methods.

methods.name: table(...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Writes tabular data.

methods.name: time(label = "default"): void
methods.description: Starts or restarts the elapsed-time measurement associated with label.

methods.name: timeEnd(label = "default"): void
methods.description: Displays elapsed milliseconds for label and removes the timer.

methods.name: timeLog(label = "default", ...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Displays elapsed milliseconds for label with any additional values, without stopping the timer.

methods.name: warn(...values: TpConsoleValue[]): void
methods.description: Writes a warning entry.

events.name: tp-console-clear
events.description: Emitted when the console is cleared.

events.name: tp-console-entry-add
events.description: Emitted when an entry is added.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-circular-color
cssproperties.description: Text color of circular-reference markers in expanded objects.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-date-color
cssproperties.description: Text color of Date values in expanded objects.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-depth
cssproperties.description: Unitless group nesting depth of a log entry; each level adds 1rem of leading indentation. Assigned internally per entry.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-entry-bg
cssproperties.description: Background of an individual log entry.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-error-color
cssproperties.description: Text color of Error values in expanded objects.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-function-color
cssproperties.description: Text color of function summaries in expanded objects.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-kind-accent
cssproperties.description: Text color and background tint of the log-level badge; assigned by the entry level.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-object-separator-color
cssproperties.description: Color of the separator between a property name and its value in expanded objects.

cssproperties.name: --tp-console-object-summary-bg
cssproperties.description: Background of the clickable summary row of an object preview.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-console>` element provides a visual console for playground output.
userHelp.interactions:
The console starts in dark mode. Its Theme button selects light, dark or automatic appearance for this console only.

#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Messages | Read output and errors. |
| Structured values | Expand or collapse values to inspect their contents. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
